title: elymus × insularis
intro: Elymus × insularis, commonly known as Island Wheat Grass, is a hybrid plant species that is a cross between Elymus condensatus and Elymus glaucus. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Island Wheat Grass include its potential to support immune function, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Elymus × insularis include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
